start: Library, the member makes a plank exercise

steps.action: Open New exercise, type the name 'Side plank'
user_sees: Screen 'New exercise' with a 'Details' list: 'How you log it', 'Main muscle', 'Equipment', 'Also works'
'How you log it' filled from the name guess until the member picks it
must_not: A guess overwriting a choice the member already made

user_sees: Sheet 'How you log it' with 'Weight and reps', 'Reps only', 'Body weight + added weight', 'Assisted (machine or band)', 'Time', 'Distance', 'Distance and time'
The row now reads 'Time'
must_not: A 'Weight goes up by' row left for a time exercise

steps.action: Tap 'Save exercise', add it to a workout
user_sees: The set table with a 'TIME' column only
No weight or reps boxes
must_not: Weight and reps boxes on a time exercise
The time saved as reps

start: A workout with Dumbbell Bench Press (Weight and reps, dumbbell)

user_sees: Sheet 'Counting', subtitle 'How Dumbbell Bench Press is typed and counted from now on. Past workouts keep theirs.'
Choices 'Two dumbbells', 'One side at a time', 'Two dumbbells, one leg at a time', 'Weight as typed' with their one-line meaning
must_not: A Counting row on a barbell exercise set to 'Weight as typed'
A Counting row on a time, distance or reps-only exercise

user_sees: The weight column reads 'KG EACH'; the target says 'each'
The total lifted counts both dumbbells
must_not: The Target and last time's weight doubled or halved by the change
The total lifted counting one dumbbell only

steps.action: On a lunge pick 'Two dumbbells, one leg at a time'
user_sees: Columns 'KG EACH' and 'REPS/SIDE'
Total lifted counts four times the typed weight times the reps
must_not: Reps counted for one side only in the total

start: New exercise screen, other kinds of logging

steps.action: Make 'Assisted pull-up' with 'Assisted (machine or band)', log a set with 20 kg help
user_sees: Weight column 'ASSIST KG'
must_not: Less help shown as a worse result

steps.action: Make 'Weighted dip' with 'Body weight + added weight'
user_sees: Weight column '+KG'
must_not: The belt weight counted as the whole load with no body weight choice

steps.action: Make 'Treadmill run' with 'Distance and time', set 'Distance in' to 'Metres' or 'Kilometres'
user_sees: Columns for distance and 'TIME'; 'MI' when the app is set to lb and miles
must_not: A distance typed in miles saved as kilometres
No Target line expected for distance work, and none shown

start: The member's own exercise that already has logged sets

user_sees: 'How you log it' shown locked
'This exercise already has logged sets, so how it is logged stays the same.'
must_not: The log type changed under old sets (weight sets read as time)

steps.action: Try to save a new exercise with an empty name
user_sees: The main button names what is missing instead of saving
must_not: An exercise saved with no name

steps.action: Type the name of an exercise already in the library
user_sees: 'Already in your library' with 'Open it' (or 'Add it to the workout')
must_not: A second copy of the same exercise made silently

user_sees: 'Could not save' 'Something went wrong saving the exercise. Please try again.'
must_not: A success screen for a failed save

start: A finished workout with Dumbbell Curl logged at 12 kg 'Weight as typed'

steps.action: Edit the finished workout, open 'Counting', pick 'Two dumbbells'
user_sees: Subtitle 'How Dumbbell Curl is counted in this workout only. Your other workouts keep theirs.'
must_not: Other workouts' counting changed

steps.action: Start a new workout with Dumbbell Curl
user_sees: Last time and the Target shown in the same physical load (6 kg each for 12 kg as typed)
must_not: The target doubled to 12 kg each

steps.action: Switch Counting back to 'Weight as typed'
user_sees: The numbers back as they were
must_not: A weight rounded away by switching back and forth

start: A gym member who shares workouts with trainers

steps.action: Log a 'Two dumbbells' set and finish the workout
user_sees: The total lifted counts both dumbbells everywhere it is shown
must_not: The trainer seeing a different total than the member for the same workout
A per-workout counting change ('this workout only') leaking into other workouts
